resources.string: Create a summary after each successful transcript. Retries may incur extra charges.

After successful manual or automatic cloud transcription, send the transcript text to the configured summary model. Retryable errors may be attempted up to three times, each potentially billable. Partial, failed and canceled runs do not trigger summaries. An existing active summary job for the same transcript prevents duplicates.
"Uses one additional short text request. Falls back to the first summary line. Applies only to recordings with their original filenames."
